name: Fairway Nine Premium 2.5D
art_direction: Polished stylized mobile/console golf; illustrated realism, not preschool/cartoon and not photorealistic.

lighting.rule: Highlights upper-left; cast shadows down-right; distant layers lighter and lower contrast.

depth_rules: Background: 55-65% contrast/detail + slight blue atmospheric tint
asset_rules: Use supplied assets as canonical art. Do not redraw trees/golfer/course props with primitive shapes.
Transform/scale/mirror supplied assets for procedural variety.
Keep physics overlays (aim/tracer/shadow/slope) dynamic and tied to actual simulation.
